configuration.title: Markdown Minimal Diff Editor
config.defaultMode.description: How a Markdown file is shown when you open it. The mode you last picked in this workspace is used instead, once you have picked one.
config.proseFontFamily.description: Font for text in the editor (CSS `font-family`). Leave empty to use VS Code's UI font. Code always uses `#editor.fontFamily#`.
config.browserPath.description: Program file of Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge or Chromium, used by **Export to PDF**. Leave empty to look in the usual places. It can only be set in your user settings.
config.customCss.description: Your own CSS for the editor, for example `.cm-md-h1 { color: orange; }`. It can only be set in your user settings, not in a workspace, so a project cannot restyle your editor.
config.renderHtml.description: Draw raw HTML blocks in Markdown files (after removing scripts, styles, forms and links that navigate). When off, HTML blocks are shown as source.
